Coverage_Description: Vet medical cover (consultation, surgery, hospitalization, diagnostics incl. CT/MRI, chemotherapy/heart disease treatment) plus third-party legal liability; up to HK$90,000 medical and HK$3,000,000 liability per policy year
pricing: Minimum premium HK$400 per policy (for termination/adjustment during policy period).
customer requirement: Applicant must be age 18+ and the pet owner in Hong Kong; insured pet must be a dog/cat living with owner in Hong Kong
price structure: Plan A/Plan B; annual premium with IA levy
additional informations: Waiting periods: illness 30 days, cancer 180 days, injury 7 days (waivable with prior 1-year similar cover); claim submission via myPrudential eClaim within 31 days; Hong Kong-only coverage with breed/pre-existing-condition exclusions
